metformin.name: Metformin
metformin.general_uses: First-line pharmacotherapy for type 2 diabetes mellitus and glycemic management alongside medical nutrition therapy.
metformin.warnings: Risk of lactic acidosis (rare but severe); withhold prior to iodinated radiocontrast procedures.
metformin.monitoring_considerations: Check baseline and periodic eGFR, serum creatinine, and annual vitamin B12 levels.
metformin.reference_dosage: Adult initial reference: 500 mg orally twice daily with meals or 850 mg once daily. Titrate by 500 mg weekly up to maximum 2000-2550 mg daily. Requires formal prescriber evaluation.

atorvastatin.name: Atorvastatin
atorvastatin.general_uses: Reduction of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), triglycerides, and prevention of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
atorvastatin.warnings: Myopathy, rhabdomyolysis, hepatic transaminase elevations, increased blood glucose.
atorvastatin.monitoring_considerations: Baseline lipid panel, ALT/AST, and creatine kinase if unexplained muscle pain or weakness occurs.
atorvastatin.reference_dosage: Adult initial reference: 10 mg to 20 mg orally once daily. High-intensity therapy: 40 mg to 80 mg daily based on ASCVD risk calculation. Requires formal prescriber evaluation.

lisinopril.name: Lisinopril
lisinopril.general_uses: Management of hypertension, heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, and renal protection in diabetic nephropathy.
lisinopril.warnings: Angioedema risk, hyperkalemia, acute kidney injury in renal artery stenosis, persistent dry cough.
lisinopril.monitoring_considerations: Serum creatinine, eGFR, and serum potassium 1-2 weeks after initiation and titration.
lisinopril.reference_dosage: Adult initial hypertension reference: 10 mg once daily. Adjust based on blood pressure response. Requires formal prescriber evaluation.

levothyroxine.name: Levothyroxine
levothyroxine.general_uses: Replacement therapy for primary, secondary, and tertiary hypothyroidism.
levothyroxine.warnings: Do not use for weight loss; excessive doses exacerbate cardiovascular conditions.
levothyroxine.monitoring_considerations: Serum TSH evaluated 6 to 8 weeks after dose initiation or adjustment.
levothyroxine.reference_dosage: Adult initial reference: 1.6 mcg/kg/day or 25-50 mcg daily in elderly or cardiac disease patients. Take on empty stomach with water 30-60 minutes before breakfast.
